entries.claim: Eden applies to top-level human-facing chat only; never Task() sub-agent I/O, evidence bundles, QA JSON, code, tool output, or generated files.
entries.notes: P0. Mis-scoping breaks machine-readable orchestration output.

entries.claim: An 8-invariant Fidelity Floor + 13 exempt content types + a default-on precision appendix guarantee accuracy survives simplification for a finance user.
entries.notes: Numbers verbatim; no dropped caveats; exempt byte-for-byte; confidence <= source; subset-only; never re-simplify; adult tone; legal terms glossed not replaced.

entries.claim: Reading levels are two-axis: FK grade + Flesch Reading Ease (surface) AND a vocabulary/jargon-definition gate (semantic). FK alone cannot separate L2 from L1.
entries.notes: Surface bands high-confidence; L1/L2 numeric bands interpolated — real split is the jargon gate.

entries.claim: Adopt knowledge-builder's language-simplification rules (scaled per level); reject its chunked tutor-loop mechanics.
entries.notes: Honest-uncertainty + source-caveat rules mandatory at ALL levels (accuracy, not clarity).

entries.claim: State = .acos/state/eden-level (digit; absent=off); first-token grammar; survive /clear (SessionStart re-arm) AND persist across sessions (exclude from session-cleanup purge).
Open decisions: never silently default a level (Confirmation Gate); per-message override (raw:/L1:) is non-persistent; silent-by-default badge; self-verification is heuristic not certified.
